WITH equipment_avg_humidity AS (
  SELECT 
    se.equipref,
    AVG(se.humepct) as avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment se
  WHERE se.humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY se.equipref
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(se.humepct) as overall_avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment se
  WHERE se.humepct IS NOT NULL
),
above_average_equipment AS (
  SELECT 
    eah.equipref,
    eah.avg_humidity,
    oa.overall_avg_humidity
  FROM equipment_avg_humidity eah
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE oa.overall_avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
    AND eah.avg_humidity > oa.overall_avg_humidity
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(avg_humidity) as group_mean
  FROM above_average_equipment
)
SELECT 
  aae.equipref,
  aae.avg_humidity,
  aae.avg_humidity - aae.overall_avg_humidity as exceeds_overall_avg,
  aae.avg_humidity - gs.group_mean as diff_from_group_mean
FROM above_average_equipment aae
CROSS JOIN group_stats gs
WHERE gs.group_mean IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN (aae.avg_humidity - gs.group_mean) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC,
  (aae.avg_humidity - gs.group_mean) DESC
LIMIT 10
